unit_name: Cebu (excl. Cebu City, Lapu-Lapu City, Mandaue City)

notes: COD-AB names the province 'Cotabato (North Cotabato)'. Before the 2024 creation of the BARMM Special Geographic Area (PH19099), its 63 barangays belonged to North Cotabato municipalities (Carmen, Kabacan, Midsayap, Pigkawayan, Pikit). The 2016-2021 reporting unit is therefore taken as PH12047 + PH19099. ASSUMPTION: reporting for those barangays stayed with North Cotabato LGUs through 2021; unverified.
Geographically enclosed by Maguindanao; administratively Region XII in the source period, BARMM after the 2019 plebiscite
Component city of Basilan but administratively in Region IX; COD-AB gives it its own admin-2 unit (PH09097), so Basilan's admin-2 polygon already excludes it

Maguindanao was split into Maguindanao del Norte (PH19087) and del Sur (PH19088) in 2022 (RA 11550, ratified 2022-09-17). The 2016-2021 province is the union of both, excluding Cotabato City, which is reported separately.
